body:
1,047,000 copies in seven days. nobody had crossed a million in an opening week since Tha Carter III — and she wrote all 14 standard-edition tracks herself, no co-writers, first and only time she's done that. tag whoever counted her out 🤍

why: GH issue #4069 fix (card t_42b5f6d8): regenerated to target the calendar's actual top-of-list era, speak-now, now that PR #4062 cleared a speak-now photo (speaknow-inglewood-2023, tags: speak-now, in social/photo-library.json). The prior red-fallback queue pair's `why` field was stale — it claimed no cleared photo existed for speak-now/folklore/1989/reputation/ttpd/evermore, which stopped being true the moment #4062 merged. 09-11 heartbeat:era-deep-cut beat (calendar). X sibling, written distinctly from the IG sibling (own hook framing, per check-drafts.mjs's cross-post-similarity gate) + the /?era=speak-now link. Hook shape = the contradiction (per calendar): a million-copy week when the record was made with zero collaborators. Sales/chart figures sourced from the Vault item 'Speak Now sells over a million copies in a single week' (supabase/seed/content/speak-now.mjs:16-40), cited to Billboard + Grammy.com + The Boot: 1,047,000 week-one copies, first album since Lil Wayne's Tha Carter III to cross a million in its opening week. The no-co-writers/'only album written entirely alone' claim is sourced from the separate Vault item 'Speak Now: the only album Taylor Swift has ever written entirely alone' (supabase/seed/content/speak-now.mjs:930-943), which scopes solo authorship to the 14 standard-edition tracks and names the deluxe bonus track 'If This Was a Movie' (Martin Johnson co-write) as the one exception — hence the X body's 'all 14 standard-edition tracks' qualifier (added in a follow-up commit after an official codex review.sh finding flagged the unqualified claim as overstating the source). No invented figures. Share hook ('tag whoever counted her out') grounded in the real no-co-writers detail. MEDIA: speaknow-inglewood-2023 (Speak Now Eras Tour set, era-matched, freshly cleared by #4062). Lyric-free, blocklist-safe. Re-queued 2026-09-10 to route through the new founder-approval gate (docs/decisions.md 2026-09-10) instead of posting under the old auto-merge path it was originally drafted under.
